desc:
🥚 Welcome to Axe To Steal An Egg!

How to Play:
🪓 Chop down trees across the map to drop eggs
🥷 Steal as many eggs back to your base
🐣 Hatch them into animals and place them on your plot
💰 Collect cash from every animal you own
🎯 Train at your Sharpening Station to grow your axe's power
⬆️ Upgrade your axe and unlock big power boosts
🏆 Buy better axes from the Basic Axe all the way to the Diamond Axe
✨ Discover rarer eggs, animals, and sizes!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Mobile, Console, and Tablet players
